fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DF10A0 (size 0x10, two zero qwords). The server notification system bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 (message kind 0x2F) fills it with the 16 bytes returned by bg3.exe+0x2B8DC50 for the entity handle in the message: that helper returns the entity's ls::uuid::Component value (bg3.exe+0x107E6F0) or the null Guid when the handle is invalid or has no uuid. So the component carries the Guid of the entity the failed sheathe/unsheathe request was about.

open_questions: Whether the entity is the character or the weapon (the sender of message kind 0x2F was not found; the character is likely).
second_pass: The single 16-byte member is established on Windows (creator bg3.exe+0x2DF10A0, notification system bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 copying the uuid Guid of the message's entity); the replication serializer (bg3.exe+0x99ADC0) has no macOS field names.
